Non-impact predicates (lexicon.table, actor.unsubscribed) are BFS-traced, polluting blastRadius and correlations.

verdicts.specQuote: For each finding from LASME + MPSE, query the graph for impact paths — what does this finding affect downstream? blast-radius ≤5 hops
verdicts.codeQuote: const adj = new Map<string, Array<{ dst: string; relation: string }>>(); for (const e of edges) { const list = adj.get(e.src) ?? []; list.push({ dst: e.dst, relation: e.relation }); adj.set(e.src, list); }
verdicts.divergence: BFS follows only outgoing edges (src→dst). Graph stores imports as src:importer→dst:imported and calls as src:caller→dst:callee. A finding at imported/callee (engine.ts) has downstream dependents as incoming edges (callers/importers). Outgoing traversal yields upstream dependencies, not downstream impact. graph-mapper.ts:path() is undirected (both src→dst and dst→src) proving downstream requires reverse lookup. Result: leaf in forward direction reports 0 downstream even with 10 dependents.
verdicts.evidence: src/hydra/instances/sro.ts:297-326 adj src→dst only; src/hydra/graph-mapper.ts:143-155 undirected adj both ways; V443 §2.5 path from finding to all callers within 5 hops requires incoming traversal

verdicts.specQuote: Every edge in the graph carries a confidence tag: EXTRACTED = explicit in source, INFERRED = graphify derived resolution. Prefer EXTRACTED, flag INFERRED with [INFERRED]. Verify each downstream node exists by reading its file
verdicts.codeQuote: impactPaths.push({ from: `${finding.file}:${finding.line}`, to: edge.dst, hops: newHops, edgeTypes: [...newPath] });
verdicts.divergence: Adjacency builder discards e.confidence; INFERRED edges counted as downstream impact without [INFERRED] flag or EXTRACTED-preferred filtering, and without downstream file-read verification. Hunt mandate requires read(320) verification of downstream file before emitting. graph-mapper preserves confidence but sro.ts drops it.
